items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1964-11-28
items.q: I said, I think, Kelly, that with your arrangement, that those things could be made popular again... And he says, yes. He says, I agree with you.

ctx.x: And he'd write a song the same way. He'd, uh, sit down and write a tune.

that the thing that would help him would be to take Joplin rags and play them in his style, and then publish those. Because I'm, I'm, uh, 60 or 70 years behind time in this music business, and sheet music is a lot to me, you see? Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. although I didn't realize that. So I broached it to him, and he was fairly enthusiastic about it. He said, yes, he thought that would do very well.
